Panels identified: A, B, a, b, c, C, D, E, F.

- A: Cartoon/schematic rendering of preconoidal rings and apical polar ring (colored 3D surface rendering, segmentation-style illustration, not a raw micrograph).

- a, b, c: Small inset schematic boxes within the central cartoon diagram, showing simplified segmented/schematic views (not raw micrographs).
- C: Grayscale tomographic slice (actual electron microscopy tomogram image) with green overlaid filament traces, orange line demarcation, and a scale bar labeled "100 nm".
- D: Cartoon/schematic 3D rendering of the pellicular actin, IMC, nuclear membrane, subpellicular microtubules etc. Colorful segmented illustration, not a raw micrograph.
- E: Small square grayscale tomographic image (raw EM tomogram slice) with colored arrowheads, scale bar labeled "25 nm".
- F: Small square grayscale/textured tomogram image (raw EM tomogram slice, N=2 noted) with colored arrowheads and cyan brackets, scale bar labeled "50 nm".
